unpinned_autoexec_runtime.description: NOT model-produced (deliberately absent from `required`): joined into scanned[] entries by the deterministic static pin check step. true = the entry declares at least one non-waived floating npx/uvx/bunx/pipx MCP-server launcher spec (code resolved from a package registry at session start, not fixed by the pinned source SHA). Documented here so downstream JSON consumers have the field contract.

unpinned_autoexec_specs.description: NOT model-produced: detail rows for unpinned_autoexec_runtime, action-emitted by the static pin check. Empty array when no floating specs.
